name: B2B CRM (Contact-Centric)
description: Contact-centric B2B CRM with companies, deals, pipelines, and lifecycle stages — powered by Commander Contacts, Tasks, Calendar, Journeys, and Docs

sections.name: Contacts & Companies
sections.purpose: Contact records linked to companies with activity timeline and notes

sections.name: Deals Pipeline
sections.purpose: Kanban pipeline tracking deals through stages with drag-and-drop

sections.name: Activities
sections.purpose: Log calls, emails, meetings, and tasks linked to contacts and deals

sections.name: Email Sequences
sections.purpose: Automated follow-up sequences powered by Commander Journeys

sections.name: Sales Dashboard
sections.purpose: Pipeline value, conversion rates, activity metrics, and forecasting

design.colorPalette: Enterprise — navy (#001126) primary, gold (#A49886) accent, blue (#3D5B6C) secondary, sand (#F5F5F0) background

what_you_build: A contact-centric B2B CRM with deal pipeline, activities, and email sequences. Replaces HubSpot and Pipedrive.
starter_prompt: I want to build a B2B CRM using the WaymakerOS CRM B2B Contact blueprint. Use host_blueprint_get with blueprint_id "crm-b2b-contact" to get the full blueprint, then guide me through building it.
seo_title: B2B CRM Template — Build with AI | WaymakerOS
seo_description: Build a custom B2B CRM with contact management, deal pipeline, and email sequences. Replaces HubSpot — built on your data.
